name: Vault Devourer
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 9

abilities.name: Relic Hunger
abilities.description: While a creature within 60 feet of the devourer carries or wields a holy relic, consecrated icon, or blessed vestment, the devourer can pinpoint the relic's bearer through walls and darkness, but its attention fixes on that relic: it must move toward the nearest sacred relic it can sense each turn unless a creature blocks its path, and any holy or consecrated matter that touches its body is eaten away.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.description: The devourer can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

abilities.name: Corrosive Form
abilities.description: A creature that touches the devourer or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage.

abilities.name: Spider Climb
abilities.description: The devourer can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devourer makes two Acid Lash attacks.

actions.name: Acid Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (7d6 + 3) acid damage.

condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, prone, restrained

generation.userConcept: a cathedral-vault ooze that digests reliquaries
